scope: regular-season games where both teams are within their first five completed D1 games against prior-year-rated opponents; unranked/new D1 opponents omitted consistently
regression_selection: minimum mean season margin RMSE over previous five seasons only, grid .50 to 1.25 by .01
pace: prior-season home tempo * prior-season away tempo / prior-season national mean tempo
unchanged_preseason_decay: 20 games, power 1.32; not applied here because the test isolates the preseason prior
limitations: Retrospective comparison; recent historical years already inspected during project development
Tests history-only forecasts, not full roster/coaching/recruiting candidates
Home advantage and pace rule held fixed across models, not fitted to target outcomes
No odds/ATS or betting profitability test
Coach metadata and historical preseason rosters are not needed or used
